name: Nahum
title: The Judge of Nineveh
summary: Nahum from Elkosh prophesied about the fall of Nineveh, the capital of the Assyrian Empire that had oppressed Israel for generations. While Jonah had preached repentance to Nineveh 150 years earlier, Nahum delivered final judgment. The prophecy was fulfilled when Nineveh fell in 612 BC.

keyEvents.title: God's Wrath Against Nineveh
keyEvents.description: Nahum began by proclaiming that the Lord is a vengeful God who does not let the guilty go unpunished.

keyEvents.title: Nineveh's Fall Foretold
keyEvents.description: Nahum vividly described how the mighty city would be destroyed.

keyEvents.title: The Reason for Judgment
keyEvents.description: Nineveh was judged for its cruelty, lies, and plundering of other nations.
